lines.text_source: Ignore him... Here you are. Have you ever thought about switching jobs?
lines.speaker: Brigard
lines.intent: dismissal + indirect advice about career change
lines.base_translation: Ignore-o... Aqui está. Já pensou em mudar de profissão?
lines.risk_notes: Tone contrast: formal military voice (Brigard) giving informal life advice could sound incongruous; back-translation needed to confirm 'switching jobs' lands as natural suggestion, not jarring. Byte budget tight (71); concision critical.
